arxiv-1510-09052.title: Anisotropic characteristics of the Kraichnan direct cascade in two-dimensional hydrodynamic turbulence
arxiv-1510-09052.creator: E.A. Kuznetsov a,b,c and E.V. Sereshchenko a,d,e
arxiv-1510-09052.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by E.A. Kuznetsov a,b,c and E.V. Sereshchenko a,d,e. Statistical characteristics of the Kraichnan direct cascade for two-dimensional hydrodynamic turbulence are numerically studied (with spatial resolution 8192 × 8192 8192\times 8192 ) in the presence of pumping and viscous-like damping. It is shown that quasi-shocks of vorticity and their Fourier partnerships in the form of jets introduce an essential influence in turbulence leading to strong angular dependencies for correlation functions.

arxiv-1903-11516.title: A purely geometrical method of determining the location of a smartphone accelerometer
arxiv-1903-11516.creator: Christopher Isaac Larnder
arxiv-1903-11516.description: Abstract In a paper ( posthumously ) co-authored by Isaac Newton himself Newton , the primacy of geometric notions in pedagogical expositions of centripetal acceleration has been clearly asserted. In the present paper we demonstrate how this pedagogical prerogative can inform the design of an experiment involving an accelerometer-equipped smartphone rotating uniformly in a horizontal plane.

arxiv-1909-01946.title: FCHL revisited: faster and more accurate quantum machine learning
arxiv-1909-01946.creator: Anders S. Christensen, Lars A. Bratholm, Felix A. Faber, O. Anatole von Lilienfeld
arxiv-1909-01946.description: Abstract We introduce the FCHL19 representation for atomic environments in molecules or condensed-phase systems. Machine learning models based on FCHL19 are able to yield predictions of atomic forces and energies of query compounds with chemical accuracy on the scale of milliseconds.

arxiv-1910-00697.title: Graphs of bounded cliquewidth are polynomially χ \chi -bounded
arxiv-1910-00697.creator: Marthe Bonamy, Michał Pilipczuk
arxiv-1910-00697.description: Abstract We prove that if 𝒞 {\cal C} is a hereditary class of graphs that is polynomially χ \chi -bounded, then the class of graphs that admit decompositions into pieces belonging to 𝒞 {\cal C} along cuts of bounded rank is also polynomially χ \chi -bounded.

arxiv-2109-00373.title: Memory Based Video Scene Parsing
arxiv-2109-00373.creator: Zhenchao Jin, Dongdong Yu, Kai Su, Zehuan Yuan, Changhu Wang
arxiv-2109-00373.description: Abstract Video scene parsing is a long-standing challenging task in computer vision, aiming to assign pre-defined semantic labels to pixels of all frames in a given video. Compared with image semantic segmentation, this task pays more attention on studying how to adopt the temporal information to obtain higher predictive accuracy.

arxiv-2109-07721.title: Blockchain for Trust and Reputation Management in Cyber-physical Systems
arxiv-2109-07721.creator: Guntur Dharma Putra, Volkan Dedeoglu, Salil S Kanhere, Raja Jurdak
arxiv-2109-07721.description: Abstract The salient features of blockchain, such as decentralisation and transparency, have allowed the development of Decentralised Trust and Reputation Management Systems (DTRMS), which mainly aim to quantitatively assess the trustworthiness of the network participants and help to protect the network from adversaries.

arxiv-2112-06869.title: The Dry Ten Martini Problem at Criticality
arxiv-2112-06869.creator: Dan S. Borgnia, Robert-Jan Slager
arxiv-2112-06869.description: Abstract We apply recently developed methods for the construction of quasi-periodic transfer matrices to the Dry Ten Martini problem for the critical almost-Mathieu Operator, also known as the Aubry-Andre-Harper (AAH) model. I Introduction The almost-Mathieu operator, \displaystyle\hat{H}=\sum_{x}t(\hat{c}^{\dagger}_{x+1}\hat{c}_{x}+\hat{c}_{x+1}\hat{c}^{\dagger}_{x})+2V\cos(\Theta x+\delta)\hat{c}^{\dagger}_{x}\hat{c}_{x}, (1) has presented a rich playground for deep mathematical questions about linear operators.

arxiv-2211-07615.title: UGIF: UI Grounded Instruction Following
arxiv-2211-07615.creator: Sagar Gubbi Venkatesh, Partha Talukdar, Srini Narayanan
arxiv-2211-07615.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sagar Gubbi Venkatesh, Partha Talukdar, Srini Narayanan. Smartphone users often find it difficult to navigate myriad menus to perform common tasks such as “ How to block calls from unknown numbers? Currently, help documents with step-by-step instructions are manually written to aid the user. The user experience can be further enhanced by grounding the instructions in the help document to the UI and overlaying a tutorial on the phone UI.

arxiv-2510-07231.title: Benchmarking LLM Causal Reasoning with Scientifically Validated Relationships
arxiv-2510-07231.creator: Donggyu Lee, Sungwon Park, Yerin Hwang, Hyoshin Kim, Hyunwoo Oh, Jungwon Kim, Meeyohng Cha, Sangyoon Park, Jihee Kim, [1em] Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Seoul National University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
arxiv-2510-07231.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Donggyu Lee, Sungwon Park, Yerin Hwang, Hyoshin Kim, Hyunwoo Oh, Jungwon Kim, Meeyohng Cha, Sangyoon Park, Jihee Kim, [1em] Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Seoul National University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. Causal reasoning is fundamental for Large Language Models (LLMs) to understand genuine cause-and-effect relationships beyond pattern matching. Existing benchmarks suffer from critical limitations such as reliance on synthetic data and narrow domain coverage.

pmc-12118702.title: Beyond glucose and Warburg: finding the sweet spot in cancer metabolism models
pmc-12118702.creator: Nia G Hammond, Robert B Cameron, Brandon Faubert
pmc-12118702.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Advances in cancer biology have highlighted metabolic reprogramming as an essential aspect of tumorigenesis and progression. However, recent efforts to study tumor metabolism in vivo have identified some disconnects between in vitro and in vivo biology. This is due, at least in part, to the simplified nature of cell culture models and highlights a growing need to utilize more physiologically relevant approaches to more accurately assess tumor metabolism.

pmc-12663491.title: Multiomics analysis of microbial succession and flavor formation mechanism during the fermentation process of Maotai-flavour Baijiu
pmc-12663491.creator: Xin Shi, Chenming Fan, Ming Hui, Qing Tian, Fangli Zhang, Chunmei Pan
pmc-12663491.description: This study employed metagenomics and metabolomics techniques to investigate the complex relationship between microbial succession and the formation of flavor compounds during the fermentation process of Maotai-flavour Baijiu. Results demonstrated that stacking fermentation, characterized by Weissella, Pichia, and Aspergillus, which secreted amylases and proteases to hydrolyze starch and proteins.

pmc-12786163.title: The Prevalence of Microorganisms on Vegetables and Fruit from Wet Markets in Chiang Mai Province, Northern Thailand
pmc-12786163.creator: Sirikwan Dokuta, Sumed Yadoung, Phadungkiat Khamnoi, Sayamon Hongjaisee, Bajaree Chuttong, Surat Hongsibsong
pmc-12786163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Foodborne diseases remain a public health issue worldwide. Inadequate attention to food safety and hygiene increases the risk of opportunistic pathogens and resistant bacteria spreading to people through the food chain, leading to foodborne diseases. To investigate food safety in our region, this study aims to measure the prevalence of microorganisms on raw food materials randomly purchased from wet markets in Chiang Mai province, Northern Thailand.

pmc-13001359.title: Rare variant analyses provide insights into the genetic architecture of endometriosis
pmc-13001359.creator: Yuanyuan Gui, Yuhan Xie, Xiaomei Tong, Hongyu Zhao
pmc-13001359.description: BackgroundEndometriosis (EMs) is a prevalent gynecologic disorder that often causes severe chronic pelvic pain and infertility. Although genome-wide association studies have identified common variants of EMs, the contribution of rare variants remains unclear.ResultsWe conducted an exome-wide analysis in 87,100 unrelated female participants of European ancestry from the UK Biobank.

pmc-13682060.creator: Yi Ding, Yuxin Deng, Haijuan Zhi, Xia Zhan, Wenjun Ji, Zizhen Gong, Lili Hao, Lianshu Han
pmc-13682060.description: ObjectiveVariants in the MMACHC gene cause combined methylmalonic acidemia (MMA) and homocystinuria, cobalamin C (cblC) type.
